invest.compare.hint: The same plan with a 2-point higher return and with 20% larger contributions.
invest.compare.note.more_rate: More risk and time spent searching
invest.scenario.name: Name
invest.scenario.emptyHint: Save a calculation to come back to it, compare it with others or turn it into a goal.
tour.planningCalculator.scenarios.title: Saved calculations
tour.planningCalculator.scenarios.body: Save a calculation under a name to come back to it. The «⋯» menu renames, copies, deletes and creates a goal that tracks the actual against this plan.
tour.planningCalculator.mode.title: What to find
tour.planningCalculator.mode.body: «Result» shows how much you end up with. The other modes find the contribution, term or rate for a target.
tour.planningCalculator.stages.title: Contribution stages
tour.planningCalculator.stages.body: A «2/5/10 years» plan: from which year and how much to put in. Indexation under the extra settings grows the contribution within a stage.
tour.planningCalculator.prefill.title: From your data
tour.planningCalculator.prefill.body: Take the balance of accounts, the deposit rate and a share of average income. What's filled in is a snapshot: refresh it with the button when you like.
tour.planningCalculator.result.title: Result
tour.planningCalculator.result.body: The result, the amount in today's money, how much went in and how much the income brought. The chart marks when a year's income overtakes the contributions.
tour.planningCalculator.compare.title: What pays off more?
tour.planningCalculator.compare.body: Compare +2 points of return with +20% on contributions. Contributions usually win: they don't depend on the market.
tour.planningCalculator.overlay.title: Comparing calculations
tour.planningCalculator.overlay.body: «Compare» draws up to three lines on the chart: «What pays more» variants and saved calculations. Click a line to open it.
tour.planningCalculator.table.title: By year and month
tour.planningCalculator.table.body: Click a year to open its months.
tour.planningSources.content.title: Your own data sources
tour.planningSources.content.body: Numbers from any website, JSON answer or file: inflation, an asset's price, a deposit rate. The app rereads them on a schedule.
tour.planningSources.add.title: New source
tour.planningSources.add.body: Paste the page address and click the number you need — the selector is built for you.
tour.planningSources.list.title: Value and state
tour.planningSources.list.body: The last value, when it was read and where it is used. After three failures in a row a source is marked «Broken» — open «Fix».
tour.planningSources.url.title: Address
tour.planningSources.url.body: A page, JSON answer or CSV/XLSX file over https://. «Open» downloads it the same way the background refresh does.
tour.planningSources.picker.title: Pick the value
tour.planningSources.picker.body: Click a number on the page, a value in the JSON tree or a table column header. The site's scripts do not run here.
tour.planningSources.method.title: How to read
tour.planningSources.method.body: The method, selector and table row can be edited by hand. The text hint helps when the site changes its markup.
tour.planningSources.test.title: Test
tour.planningSources.test.body: Read the value with the current settings before saving.
tour.planningSources.uses.title: Where the value goes
tour.planningSources.uses.body: A currency's inflation, an asset's price or a deposit rate. In workflows a source is a «Source value» node and a trigger.
whatsNew.calculator.title: Investment calculator
whatsNew.calculator.calc: Planning → Calculator: compound interest with staged contributions, compounding, tax, inflation and regular withdrawals.
whatsNew.calculator.reverse: The calculator also works backwards: how much to contribute, how long, or at what rate a target is reached.
whatsNew.calculator.prefill: «From your data» fills in the balance of accounts, the deposit rate and a contribution as a share of average income.
whatsNew.calculator.scenarios: Calculations are saved under a name, compared on one chart, and checked for «what pays off more».
whatsNew.calculator.goal: A calculation can become a goal: its card shows how much there should be by today according to the plan, and how much there is.
whatsNew.emergency.title: Essential spending and the emergency fund
whatsNew.emergency.essential: Everyday categories can be marked essential — groceries, medicine and transport already are. Together with fixed costs they make up the basic costs of a month.
whatsNew.emergency.fund: A savings account can join the emergency fund with a switch in its settings. Changing its purpose or archiving it takes it out.
whatsNew.health.title: Capital checkup
whatsNew.health.light: Analytics has a new Checkup tab: a traffic light with reasons and first steps, the emergency fund in months, the debt load, the savings rate and the freedom index. Once a month you get a notice if the rating changed.
whatsNew.assetClasses.title: Baskets and the top-up helper
whatsNew.assetClasses.advisor: Analytics → Investments has a helper: it shows how much to put into each basket to come closer to the target shares (40 / 40 / 20 by default).
whatsNew.assetClasses.wallet: Wallet settings set a basket for all its assets; a single asset gets its own in «Assets by basket».
whatsNew.assetClasses.networth: The «Net worth» card shows financial assets by basket, with the emergency fund apart.
whatsNew.passive.title: Passive income
whatsNew.passive.categories: New income categories: dividends, coupons, staking and rent. They show up in existing vaults too.
whatsNew.passive.flag: Category settings can mark income as passive. Deposit interest, Bybit Earn, dividends, coupons, staking and rent are marked from the start; cashback and gifts are not.
whatsNew.loanKinds.title: Loans by kind
whatsNew.loanKinds.networth: The net worth card splits what you owe into mortgages, loans, cards and installments when you have more than one kind.
whatsNew.goalReturn.title: Goals with a return
whatsNew.goalReturn.return: A goal can have an expected return: the monthly need and the forecast count the interest.
whatsNew.goalReturn.manual: While history is short, the budget settings take your usual income and spending: goals and the calculator use them for the free surplus.
whatsNew.inflationAuto.title: Inflation and the key rate, automatically
whatsNew.inflationAuto.auto: RUB, USD and EUR inflation now comes from open data once a day (Bank of Russia, BLS, Eurostat), month by month. In Settings → Money → Inflation keep “Auto” or enter your own value (“Manual”).
whatsNew.inflationAuto.notices: A new inflation figure or a key rate change sends a notification; turn it off under “Inflation and rates”.
whatsNew.inflationAuto.keyRate: The key rate for the deposit interest tax now refreshes in the background, not when the widget opens.
auth.baseCurrencyHint: Totals, net worth and reports across the app are counted in it. You can change it later in Settings.
auth.crypto.title: Will you track crypto?
auth.crypto.noHint: Cash, banks, deposits, property. Crypto wallets and exchanges stay hidden.
auth.crypto.yesHint: Also crypto wallets, exchanges, coins and their prices.
auth.crypto.later: You can change this in Settings, under «Direction».
settings.direction.title: Direction
settings.direction.description: What you track in this vault. The setting is shared by every device of the vault.
settings.direction.cryptoHint: Off: crypto wallets, exchanges, coins and trading widgets are hidden. Their data and balances stay and still count in totals.
settings.direction.willHide: Crypto wallets hidden when turned off: {count}
whatsNew.vaultSetup.title: A vault set up for you
whatsNew.vaultSetup.currency: The first time you create or open a vault, the app asks for your base currency.
whatsNew.vaultSetup.direction: When creating a vault you can skip crypto: crypto wallets, exchanges and coins are hidden. Turn them back on in Settings → Vault → «Direction».

tour.money.period.title: Period and wallets
tour.money.period.body: The arrows step through months; a click on the month opens quick periods and a month grid. Shift + click picks a range.
tour.money.months.title: By month
tour.money.months.body: Grey is what came in, colour what went out. The dashed line is the average; under each bar, what the month left.
tour.money.categories.title: Categories
tour.money.categories.body: Share, amount and the monthly average. «Set limit» opens a limit on the category right away.
tour.money.more.title: More in Money
tour.money.more.body: Capital, investments, the month's balance, the checkup and the calculator; the open one shows on the button.

tour.money.balanceMonths.body: What came in, what went out and what was left in each month. Click a bar to open that month.
tour.money.carryOver.title: Carry over what is left
tour.money.carryOver.body: Turn it on and each month's leftover moves into the next one: the table gains a «Carried on» line.
whatsNew.newShell.title: A new menu and the Money section
whatsNew.newShell.sections: Five sections instead of nine: Home, Transactions, Wallets, Money and Automations. Old links and pins lead to the new places.
whatsNew.newShell.fold: The menu folds with «Collapse» or Ctrl B, and by itself in a narrow window. Ctrl N records a transaction from any screen.
whatsNew.newShell.spending: «Money › Spending» answers in one sentence — how much went out and on what — with a row of 12 months and the usual month per category.
whatsNew.newShell.month: «Month balance» shows what each month left and can carry the unspent on.
whatsNew.newShell.automations: Automations live in one section: «Mine» and «Journal», the rest under «More».

tour.dashboard.figures.title: Three figures
tour.dashboard.figures.body: Net worth and its change this month, what you spent this month and what you can spend today — explained under the amount.
tour.dashboard.tasks.title: To do
tour.dashboard.tasks.body: Only what needs action: an overdue bill, a run to confirm, a reminder. Each has its own button; «Hide until tomorrow» clears the block for the day.
tour.dashboard.changes.title: What changed
tour.dashboard.changes.body: Operations since your last visit, by day. A row opens the operation; right-click for actions.
whatsNew.newHome.title: A new Home
whatsNew.newHome.figures: Three figures on top: net worth, spent this month and what you can spend today — explained.
whatsNew.newHome.tasks: «To do» holds only what needs action, each with its own button — overdue utility bills and reminders included.
whatsNew.newHome.changes: «What changed» lists operations since your last visit, by day.
whatsNew.newHome.widgets: Widgets are now optional: switch them on in «Widgets on Home» and they go below. Your saved layout is unchanged.

tour.money.categorySheet.title: A category, opened
tour.money.categorySheet.body: The category's spending by month, its operations and limit — without leaving Spending.
tour.money.whereAnswer.title: Where the money went
tour.money.whereAnswer.body: In one sentence: what came in, what went on spending and what is still unassigned.
tour.money.whereTable.title: Open in place
tour.money.whereTable.body: «Between your own», «Lent» and «Invested» open right in the table, with a link to those operations.
tour.money.wealthHead.title: Net worth
tour.money.wealthHead.body: How much you have in total and how it changed over the period.
tour.money.wealthTable.title: By group
tour.money.wealthTable.body: Banks, crypto, property and debts in a stack; a group opens down to wallets.
tour.money.investFigures.title: Investments
tour.money.investFigures.body: How much is invested, what it is worth now and the result.
tour.money.investTable.title: Positions
tour.money.investTable.body: Each position with its entry price and result; «Record a trade» and «Plan a trade» start here.
tour.money.balanceDays.title: By day
tour.money.balanceDays.body: How the month's balance moved day by day and what you can spend per day until the month ends.
tour.money.healthFigures.title: Checkup
tour.money.healthFigures.body: The key figures of your financial health: cushion, debts, savings.
tour.money.planNext.title: What's next
tour.money.planNext.body: The next steps on limits and goals: what to set or top up.
whatsNew.newMoney.title: New Money
whatsNew.newMoney.where: «Where it went»: one sentence about the month and a table whose rows open in place.
whatsNew.newMoney.plan: «Plan»: limits and goals on one screen; a limit or a goal takes two steps.
whatsNew.newMoney.wealth: «Net worth» and «Investments» stack by group; a trade can be recorded and planned.
whatsNew.newMoney.calculator: Calculator: plans compare on one chart, and there is an exchange trade calculator.
whatsNew.newPaths.title: Quick paths
whatsNew.newPaths.glance: Blue dotted figures and names open a quick glance without leaving the screen.
whatsNew.newPaths.back: Going from a report to Operations leaves a «← back» chip to the report.
whatsNew.newPaths.palette: Ctrl K: recent items, Alt 1…5 jumps and a glance at the selection on the right.
whatsNew.newPaths.menu: One menu on an operation row: right click, «⋯» or a long press on a phone; keys are shown.
whatsNew.newPaths.auto: The «auto» mark says which automation recorded the operation.

tour.directory.accounts.body: Copy a number and press Ctrl V anywhere — a card, phone or address is recognised. An old requisite can be made inactive.

whatsNew.newOps.select: Tick several operations to change the category or wallet, or delete them at once — with «Undo».
whatsNew.newOps.calendar: The calendar shows what is left this month and how much you can spend on the days ahead.
whatsNew.newOps.contacts: Contacts and debts, requisites and bonuses live under «More» in Operations.
whatsNew.newOps.form: Ctrl N opens the short form: errors under the fields, Ctrl Enter saves and starts the next one.
whatsNew.newOps.deal: On an exchange, «Spot», «Futures» and «DeFi» open a deal on that exchange right away.

tour.automationsMine.create.title: New automation
tour.automationsMine.create.body: A wizard with three questions: what, what to do, when. Ready-made forms: “Salary”, a reminder with a “Pay” button, a price alert, “Pay yourself first”.
tour.automationsMine.list.title: Everything that runs by itself
tour.automationsMine.list.body: Repeats, workflows, reminders and alerts in one list. The chips on top filter, the switch turns one on or off, a click on a row opens its card on the right.
tour.automationsMine.starts.title: Where to start
tour.automationsMine.starts.body: Four ready-made starts. Pick one and the wizard fills in the fields for you.
tour.automationsMine.import.title: Import
tour.automationsMine.import.body: Load a .json file with a workflow. If it has wallets we do not know, we offer to swap them for yours.
tour.workflowEditor.words.title: In words
tour.workflowEditor.words.body: The workflow in one line: “when … → ask … → transfer …”. You see what it does without studying the canvas.
tour.workflowEditor.node.title: Node
tour.workflowEditor.node.body: The fields of the selected node and its help (F1). If a required field is empty, the error shows right in the node.
tour.workflowEditor.steps.title: Steps
tour.workflowEditor.steps.body: On a phone the workflow is a list of steps, and a step’s fields open in a sheet. The button next to it switches to the canvas.
whatsNew.newAutomations.title: New “Automations”
whatsNew.newAutomations.mine: “Mine” is one list of everything that runs by itself: repeats, workflows, reminders and alerts. It has filters and a hint on where to start.
whatsNew.newAutomations.card: Click a row and its card opens on the right: what it does and when it last ran.
whatsNew.newAutomations.journal: The journal is one list; a run waiting for an answer is confirmed with the “Confirm” button in its row.
whatsNew.newAutomations.wizard: A new automation is a wizard with three questions: what, what to do, when. Ready-made forms: “Salary”, a reminder with a “Pay” button, a price alert, “Pay yourself first”.
whatsNew.newAutomations.scheme: Workflow: a one-line toolbar, “In words” retells the workflow, node settings on the side. Ctrl Space adds a node.
whatsNew.newAutomations.emulate: Emulation numbers the steps, and an error shows right in the node. On a phone the workflow is a list of steps, fields open in a sheet.
whatsNew.newAutomations.import: A workflow can be loaded from a .json file: wallets we do not know are offered to be swapped for yours.
